## Summary

- define explicit sRGB-color vs linear-data material texture semantics
- guarantee exactly one SDR output transfer through sRGB or shader encoding
- fix procedural shared-toon color texture source encoding
- record the renderer color pipeline in ADR 0118

## Scope

This is the first renderer-foundation phase only. It does not add MMD-specific rendering, expand the material schema, or introduce tangent/IBL/temporal features.
